blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: PART XXVI - Entering the Heart of Bhairava
blocks.directed: PART XXVI - Entering the Heart of Bhairava

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: *Abhinavagupta has spent twenty-five installments explaining how the entire universe can be expressed through sacred phonemes. Now he reaches the Heart and discovers a problem: people have started trying to enter it as though it were a room.*
blocks.directed: *Abhinavagupta has spent twenty-five installments explaining how the entire universe can be expressed through sacred phonemes. Now he reaches the Heart and discovers a problem: people have started trying to enter it as though it were a room.*

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: *He explains why Śiva is the essence of Śakti's universe, why the Goddess's hips are suddenly a metaphysical subject, why worship can loosen bondage even before understanding has matured, and why declaring “I have entered the Heart” might be precisely the thought preventing you from recognizing it.*
blocks.directed: *He explains why Śiva is the essence of Śakti's universe, why the Goddess's hips are suddenly a metaphysical subject, why worship can loosen bondage even before understanding has matured, and why declaring “I have entered the Heart” might be precisely the thought preventing you from recognizing it.*

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: *Then the ritual traditions arrive with triangles, divine unions, flowers, incense, two mudrās, sixteen powers, seventeen lunar principles and multiple ways of extracting an entire cosmology from the phrase “joined with fourteen.”*
blocks.directed: *Then the ritual traditions arrive with triangles, divine unions, flowers, incense, two mudrās, sixteen powers, seventeen lunar principles and multiple ways of extracting an entire cosmology from the phrase “joined with fourteen.”*
